description:
Job Description 

  Expertise in Core Java with knowledge of multithreading, concurrency, memory management and NIO. Should have extensive experience in using concurrent package
 Expertise in Enterprise Java or any other server/client architectures with asynchronous or non-blocking request/response
 Working knowledge of JDBC and data modeling.
 Working knowledge of Splunk desirable.
 Knowledge of Unix Shell scripting; PERL scripting would be desirable.
 Candidate needs to be ready for 2-3 rounds of technical interview, coding interview. 
 
 6 -12 months contract
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
